'''Lieutenant Major''' was a rank in-use by the [[Imperial Military (Sith Empire)|military]] of the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|reconstituted Sith Empire]] during the [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]].<ref name="TOR:PA">{{TORcite|type=class|Bounty Hunter|Pirrell's Ambitions|Balmorra}}</ref>

==Behind the scenes==
The rank of Lieutenant Major first appeared in the [[2011]] [[Star Wars video games|video game]], ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]'', used by [[Pirrell]]. Unlike most other military ranks featured in the series, the rank Lieutenant Major is not based of any real military rank, but was instead created for the game.<ref name="TOR:PA" />

==Appearances==
*''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]'' {{1st}}
